description_text: Amendment 0001 is being issued to (1) Extend Due Date for Proposals; (2) Update SF 1449 Box 20, Instructions to Offerors , and add EPA Fuel Surcharge Clause; (3) Update counties and include Privacy, HIPPA Compliance, Information Security , and Record Management language in PWS; (4) Update Vendor Questionnaire; and (5) Provide Answers to Vendor Questions. All proposals are due NLT Monday June 1, 2026, at 10:00 AM CDT via e-mail to the following email address: anitra.carter@va.gov and astrid.mckinney@va.gov.
